name: Mansa Musa
role: Ruler of Mali from c. 1312 to c. 1337
contribution: The ninth Mansa of the Mali Empire, which reached its territorial peak during his reign.

checks.lead: Mansa Musa (c. 1280 – c. 1337) was the ninth Mansa of the Mali Empire, which reached its territorial peak during his reign. Musa's reign is often regarded as the zenith of Mali's power and prestige, although he features less in Mandinka oral traditions than his predecessors.
